issues.title: This vertically scrollable section element is not included in sequential focus navigation, nor does it have any descendants that are.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: As a keyboard-only user, I cannot access the content that is hidden within the scrollable section. Because the section itself is not focusable, I cannot use my keyboard's arrow keys to scroll down and read the full text. This effectively locks me out of the content.
remediation_instructions: Make the scrollable `<section>` focusable by adding the `tabindex="0"` attribute to it.
This will include the element in the default tab order, allowing keyboard users to navigate to it and use arrow keys to scroll.
Ensure there is a visible focus indicator for the section when it receives focus, so users know they can interact with it.
expected_tool_change: A keyboard navigation test will show that the scrollable section can be tabbed to and scrolled using the up and down arrow keys.
An automated tool might not flag this issue directly, as it often requires manual testing to verify keyboard operability of custom widgets or scrollable regions.
